summary:
Found and fixed the incorrect comparison in the next-permutation logic: the inner search for the swap partner used `perm[j] < perm[i]` instead of `perm[j] > perm[i]`, causing it to pick a smaller element and produce the wrong lexicographic successor. Changed to `>` so it correctly finds the smallest element larger than the pivot.

RESULT: FIXED
diff:
--- a/program.py
+++ b/program.py
@@ -3,7 +3,7 @@
     for i in range(len(perm) - 2, -1, -1):
         if perm[i] < perm[i + 1]:
             for j in range(len(perm) - 1, i, -1):
-                if perm[j] < perm[i]:
+                if perm[j] > perm[i]:
                     next_perm = list(perm)
                     next_perm[i], next_perm[j] = perm[j], perm[i]
                     next_perm[i + 1:] = reversed(next_perm[i + 1:])
